maria_partners: Quick update  We closed a renewal + marketplace listing with Orion Healthcare today. They signed a 2-year Dedicated contract and will co-author a case study.

lee_sales: Awesome! Any performance wins from the pilot?

dan_engineering: Pilot numbers: 48% drop in GPU hours after route-based caching + quantization profiles. Average latency for their patient-triage endpoint fell from ~720ms to ~260ms.

tara_marketing: Nice metrics. Do we have permission to publish the logo and a short quote?

maria_partners: Legal cleared marketing assets and a short quote. They'll do a launch webinar next month.

ci-bot: task created: "Orion case study & marketplace launch" assignees: tara_marketing, dan_engineering, lee_sales. Due: 2026-06-02. Link: https://redwood/ops/tasks/4219

lee_sales: Can someone add two slides for sales enablement with contract highlights and recommended talking points?

dan_engineering: I'll prepare a one-paragraph tech appendix (cache config + quant settings) and attach the dashboard screenshot.

tara_marketing: I'll draft the blog and landing page; will post drafts in #marketing-review tomorrow.

maria_partners: We'll announce this in the Monday all-hands as a customer win. Thanks team :tada:
